🔗 Gno.land Contribution
My involvement with gno.land started with Testnet 13, followed by Topaz, Sapphire and Pearl.
Throughout these testnet phases, I have:

* Deployed and operated gno.land nodes
* Participated in Testnet 13, Topaz, Sapphire and Pearl
* Prepared node installation and setup guides
* Created technical documentation to help operators deploy and maintain Gno infrastructure
* Contributed infrastructure and tooling to the ecosystem

Beyond running nodes, I also developed and operated Gno.land Hub, including its explorer and ecosystem tools.
🛠️ Long-Term Contribution
My focus is on building reliable, secure and continuously monitored infrastructure.
I aim to contribute to gno.land not only as a validator, but also through infrastructure, technical documentation, tools and community resources.
Having participated in gno.land from Testnet 13 through Topaz, Sapphire and Pearl, I look forward to continuing this contribution as the ecosystem moves forward.
